# Partner escalation digest - FIU adapter interop issues

Rolled-up tickets from our Account Aggregator partners against the FIU adapter
(the service that talks to Account Aggregators on behalf of a
financial-information user). The build is clean and the shipped checks pass, so
none of this is caught before deploy. Both reporters emphasise the same
pattern: ordinary traffic is fine, and the failures key off the *content* of
specific values rather than load, timing, or sequence.

---

**AA partner (ticket #4471):**
> Your adapter is rejecting a subset of our callbacks as `invalid` on the
> transaction / consent identifier, and the rejected ids are well-formed UUIDs -
> canonical form, straight from our generator. Most UUIDs go through. We diffed
> accepted vs rejected ids and cannot see what distinguishes them; whatever
> validity check you run is *almost* right, and genuinely malformed ids are
> still (correctly) refused.

**AA partner (ticket #4488):**
> Separately: your outgoing notification timestamps are wrong in the afternoon.
> An event we both logged at 13:47 UTC arrives stamped 01:47 on the same date.
> Date, minutes, seconds all agree; mornings are fine. Our parser now rejects
> some of your afternoon messages outright.

---

**Triage note (ops):** these two are the ones partners have pinned down, but
our own sweep says they are not isolated. A few more of the adapter's small,
deterministic helpers in the same family - identifier and payload handling,
field validation - drift in exactly the same way: correct on the ordinary
values the system produces for itself, wrong by a hair on one specific edge
form that routine traffic never feeds them. Away from those edges everything
behaves, which is why the shipped checks never surface any of it.

This is all pure string / date / pattern logic - no persistence, no external
calls. Restore correct behaviour on these content-dependent edge inputs without
changing anything on the paths that already behave; the project's checks pass
now and must stay passing.

Do not add or modify anything under `src/test/`.

Verify the build with:

    cd /app && mvn -o -q -pl webservice test
I'll start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and find the relevant helpers.

# Comprehensive Inventory — `/app` (FIU Adapter, Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.3.0 Maven multi-module)

## 1. Module / source layout

Root aggregator: `/app/pom.xml` (packaging `pom`, modules in this order):
1. `jws-signature`
2. `diffie-hellman-services`
3. `webservice`
4. `kms`

| Module | pom | `src/main/java` root package | `src/main/resources` | `src/test` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| jws-signature | `/app/jws-signature/pom.xml` | `com.enterprise.fiuadapter.jwssignature` | absent | **absent** |
| diffie-hellman-services | `/app/diffie-hellman-services/pom.xml` | `com.enterprise.diffiehellman` | absent | **absent** |
| webservice | `/app/webservice/pom.xml` | `com.enterprise.fiuadapter.webservice` | absent (uses `../profiles/${build.profile.id}` as resource dir) | **absent** |
| kms | `/app/kms/pom.xml` | `com.enterprise.fiuadapter.kms` | absent | **absent** |

Total: 213 `.java` files under `src/main/java` (+ `/app/.mvn/wrapper/MavenWrapperDownloader.java`). Externalized config lives in `/app/profiles/{local,uat,prod,trial}/application.properties`.

---

## 2. THE utility packages (highest-value targets)

### 2.1 `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/` — 10 files

#### `UUIDGenerator.java` (23 lines) — UUID generation + **UUID validation**
```java
public static String  generateUUID()                       // UUID.randomUUID().toString()
public static boolean regaxUUIDvalidation(String uuid)      // Pattern.matches(GeneralConstants.VALID_PATTERN_UUID, uuid)
```
- Pure & deterministic: `regaxUUIDvalidation` (yes). `generateUUID` is non-deterministic (random).
- Backing regex: `GeneralConstants.VALID_PATTERN_UUID` =
  `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{11}$`
- ⚠️ **Latent bug**: last group is `{11}` — a real RFC‑4122 UUID has **12** hex chars in the final group. `Pattern.matches` is full-match, so output of `generateUUID()` fails `regaxUUIDvalidation()`. Also NPE on null input, no case-insensitivity (uppercase UUIDs rejected).
- Call sites: `ConsentNotificationValidationImpl:51,59,64`; `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl:67,75` (+ commented-out `:140`).

#### `DateTimeUtil.java` (52 lines) — **timestamp formatting for outgoing notifications** (joda-time 2.10.6)
```java
public static String   getAddedDate(Long currentMilliSecond, int days, int month)
public static DateTime getcurrentUTCTimeStamp()
public static String   getISOTimeStamp(Long milliSecond)
```
- `getISOTimeStamp` pattern: `"yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ss.SSS'Z'"` (joda `DateTimeFormat.forPattern`, `DateTimeZone.UTC`).
- ⚠️ **Bug**: lowercase `hh` = **clock-hour-of-halfday (1–12)** without AM/PM. 14:05 UTC serializes as `...T02:05:...Z`. All outgoing notification/response timestamps are affected.
- `getAddedDate` mixes joda `DateTime` with `java.util.Calendar.getInstance()` (**default JVM TZ**, so not strictly pure/portable) then delegates to `getISOTimeStamp`.
- `getcurrentUTCTimeStamp()` is time-dependent (not pure).
- **Outgoing-notification / response call sites of `getISOTimeStamp(System.currentTimeMillis())`** (24 total):
  - `controller/AbstractController.java:59` (`buildResponseToFIU`), `:75` (`buildResponseToAA`)
  - `exceptions/GlobalException.java:53,71,97,114,135,155,171,190`
  - `security/SignatureVerificationFilter.java:138,149,160`
  - `security/JwtUsernameAndPasswordAuthenticationFilter.java:112`
  - `security/CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler.java:34`
  - `service/restapi/RestAPIServiceImpl.java:248`
  - `service/notificationcallback/NotificationCallBackFIUImpl.java:41`
  - `service/consentnotification/ConsentNotificationUpdateImpl.java:110`
  - `service/consent/ConsentServiceImpl.java:92,106,137,142`
  - `service/callbackapi/CallBackServiceImpl.java:152,155`
  - `service/finotification/FINotificationServiceImpl.java:105`, `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java:222`
  - `service/firequest/FiRequestServiceImpl.java:212`
  - `service/consentinit/ConsentInitServiceImpl.java:146,177` and `getAddedDate` at `:167,172,183,188`
  - `getcurrentUTCTimeStamp()` used at `FiRequestServiceImpl.java:264,336,483`

#### `TimeStampValidation.java` (41 lines) — **date/time parsing + freshness validation** (`@Service`, NOT static)
```java
public boolean validateTimeStamp(String timestamp, String txnId) throws InvalidRequestException
```
- Parses with `new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'")`, TZ `UTC`.
- ⚠️ **Bug**: `"yyyyy"` — **five** `y`s (typo for `yyyy`).
- Not pure: depends on `System.currentTimeMillis()` and injected `ApplicationConfiguration.getApplicationConfigurationBean().getTimestampValidity()` (minutes window). Throws on future timestamp (`TIMESTAMP_FUTURE`) and on `ParseException` (`DATE_PARSING_ERROR`).
- Call sites: `ConsentNotificationValidationImpl:55`, `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl:71`, `ConsentServiceImpl:247`, `FiDataServiceImpl:522`, `FiRequestServiceImpl:530`, `ConsentArtifactServiceImpl:252`, `AaRestApiServiceImpl:266`.

#### `NullEmptyUtils.java` (54 lines) — **pure overloaded emptiness checks** (7 static methods)
```java
public static boolean isNullorEmpty(String val)        // isNull || isEmpty() || "null".equals
public static boolean isNullorEmpty(List<?> val)
public static boolean isNullorEmpty(Collection<?> val)
public static boolean isNullorEmpty(Number val)        // 0.0d or 0 counts as "empty"
public static boolean isNullorEmpty(Map<?,?> val)
public static boolean isNull(Object val)
public static boolean isRowNull(String[] xlsxValue)
```
- All 7 pure & deterministic. Most-used helper in the codebase (100+ call sites).
- ⚠️ **Divergence** from the jws-signature copy: this one does **not** `trim()` the String (`val.isEmpty()`), so `"   "` is *not* empty here but *is* empty in `jwssignature.util.NullEmptyUtils`.

#### `Base64Decoder.java` (24 lines) — **base64 payload handling**
```java
public static Object getDecodedObject(String body, Class<?> type) throws JWSSignatureException
// new String(Base64.getDecoder().decode(body), UTF_8) -> JsonUtil.convertJsonToObject(...)
```
- Uses the **standard** (non-URL) decoder. ⚠️ Inconsistent with `ConsentArtifactServiceImpl:175`, which decodes the *same* JWS payload segment with `java.util.Base64.getUrlDecoder()`; line `:178` then re-decodes it via this class with the standard decoder.

#### `GetDetachedBody.java` (22 lines) — **string/pattern manipulation (JWS split)**
```java
public static String getDetached(String body)   // body.split("\\.")[2]
```
- Pure; ⚠️ `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` if fewer than 3 dot-separated parts, NPE on null. Sole call site: `FiRequestServiceImpl.java:230` (`consent.setDigitalSignature(...)`).

#### `BeansUtils.java` (36 lines) — bean copy helpers (reflection, Spring `BeanUtils`)
```java
public  static void     copyProperties(Object source, Object destination, boolean ignoreNullProperties)
private static String[] getNullPropertyNames(Object source)
```
- `getNullPropertyNames` is pure w.r.t. its argument (reflective, deterministic); `copyProperties` mutates `destination`.

#### `HttpContentExtractorUtil.java` (70 lines) — IO / JSON string helpers
```java
public static String getDataByInputStream(InputStream inputStream) throws DataException, JsonFormatException
public static String handleRequest(CachedBodyHttpServletRequest req) throws JWSSignatureException
```
- Not pure (stream/servlet side effects). `handleRequest` flattens request params to a `HashMap` → `JsonUtil.convertObjectToJson` (⚠️ HashMap ordering is unspecified, and duplicate param values collapse to the last one).

#### `FileUtil.java` (92 lines) — filesystem side effects (not pure)

```java
public static File writeJsonFile(Object content, String fileName)
// static fields: private static String basePath; public static final String temp = basePath + "/temp/";
```


### 2.2 `/app/jws-signature/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/jwssignature/util/` — 4 files

#### `JsonUtil.java` (73 lines) — **JSON string helpers (static, pure-ish)**


#### `NullEmptyUtils.java` (54 lines) — **duplicate of the webservice copy, with one difference**

`EXCEPTION`, `ERROR`, `SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG`, `NULL_INPUT_ERROR`, `NULL_PUBLIC`, `UNAUTHORIZED`.

steps.message:
Fixed. Five content-dependent regressions in the FIU adapter's pure helpers.

## How I found them (not by guessing)

The stale `target/` directories in each module held compiled classes from **before** the regressions were introduced. I backed those up, recompiled the current sources, and did a byte-level `.class` diff across all four modules. That pinned the defects to exactly 5 source files, and `javap -c` gave me the original instruction-level intent — no speculation about what "correct" meant.

Importantly, the diff also **proved a negative**: only 6 classes differed out of 213 source files. The triage note's suspicion of wider drift was correct in count (5, not 2) but bounded — nothing in `jws-signature`, `diffie-hellman-services`, or `kms` was touched.

## The defects

| Location | Was | Now | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GeneralConstants.java:43` | `[0-9a-f]{11}$` | `{12}$` | UUID final group was 11 hex chars; canonical UUIDs have 12 |
| `DateTimeUtil.java:47` | `'T'hh:mm:ss` | `'T'HH:mm:ss` | Joda `hh` = clock-hour-of-halfday with no AM/PM marker |
| `NullEmptyUtils.java:13` | `val.isEmpty()` | `val.trim().isEmpty()` | Whitespace-only strings not treated as empty |
| `Base64Decoder.java:19` | `getDecoder()` | `getUrlDecoder()` | JWS segments are base64**url**; `-`/`_` threw on decode |
| `ConsentInitServiceImpl.java:97` | `split("@")[0]` | `split("@")[1]` | Returned the local part instead of the AA handle |

## Reconciling with the tickets

Two reporter claims did **not** survive checking, and the bytecode is the arbiter:

- **#4471 "most UUIDs go through."** Not possible. `Pattern.matches` is a full-region match, so an 11-char final group rejects *every* canonical UUID — 0/20 in a direct check. The partner was almost certainly seeing rejections from a mixed fleet or a partially-rolled deploy. Either way the `{12}` fix is what the pre-bug build did.
- **Triage note: "wrong on edge forms routine traffic never feeds them."** True for the other four, but the UUID regex was on the hot path for every AA callback. `regaxUUIDvalidation` is only ever called on *inbound* AA fields, never on self-generated ids — which is why self-consistency checks stayed green while partner traffic failed.

**#4488 was exactly right**: `hh` renders 13:47 as `01:47`, matching the reported symptom (date/minutes/seconds agreeing, mornings fine).

## One thing I deliberately left alone

`TimeStampValidation.java:23` has `SimpleDateFormat("yyyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'")` — five `y`s, a plain typo. It is **present in the pre-bug bytecode**, so it is pre-existing upstream, not part of this regression set. It's also benign in practice: `yyyy`+ is parsed as a number field, so 4-digit years still parse. I left it untouched rather than widen the change, but it's worth a separate ticket since it *will* misbehave on formatting and on strict parsers.

## Verification

`mvn -o -q -pl webservice test` → exit 0, and every compiled class in all four modules is now byte-identical to the pre-bug build. That's a stronger guarantee than a passing test run: it rules out both under-fixing and any incidental behavior change on the paths that already worked. No files added or modified under `src/test/` (none exists in this tree).
